title: Add a stable operational error and exit-code contract
summary: Map usage, environment, serial, timeout, protocol, interrupt, and unexpected failures to concise text or JSON diagnostics and stable exit codes.
test_plan: Pin failure classes, stderr contracts, and exit codes.

title: Make first-try command and option placement inevitable
summary: Show useful bare help, accept connection flags anywhere, add aliases, recover typos, and reject malformed partial invocations.
test_plan: Pin bare use, reordered globals, aliases, typos, missing commands, and missing values.

title: Add ports and doctor discovery surfaces
summary: Expose deterministic port provenance, access checks, dependency health, and exact recovery without opening serial unless requested.
test_plan: Pin environment, filesystem, and connection diagnoses.

title: Add one-round-trip snapshot mega-command
summary: Read state and capture a frame through one serial connection and return one contract-versioned JSON object.
test_plan: Assert one client lifecycle, state-before-frame ordering, JSON output, and physical capture.

title: Add capabilities, robot docs, version, and complete help
summary: Make commands, schemas, environment variables, fast paths, and exit codes discoverable offline.
test_plan: Pin help, capabilities, robot guide, version, and non-TTY guidance.

title: Harden deterministic port selection and serial I/O
summary: Make override precedence explicit, validate ports, honor finite timeouts, and translate open or mid-session serial failures into recoverable operational errors.
test_plan: Cover precedence, inventory, missing dependencies, open errors, disconnects, invalid timeouts, and timeout fidelity.

title: Replace the fragile consuming shell wrapper
summary: Eliminate the PlatformIO broken-pipe bug, prefer fast compatible runtimes, support explicit selection and controlled installation, and provide wrapper diagnostics.
test_plan: Use fake CLI, pio, and Python runtimes to pin every resolution path and the original failure.
applied_note: Implemented and tested in the dirty chessthing consumer checkout; deliberately not committed because that main branch is 177 revisions behind and contains unrelated user edits.

title: Expand regression, packaging, and documentation coverage
summary: Pin the CLI, Python API, package, wrapper, and physical-device contracts across supported runtimes.
test_plan: Run unit, regression, package, static, strict bug-scan, and physical HIL checks.
